sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Announcement dated September 28, 2026 identifies the exact model and its Claude 5.5 family membership.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact model specifications identify claude-sonnet-5-5, release on September 28, 2026, active status, 1M-token context, text/image input, text output and adaptive thinking.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full 148-page PDF downloaded with curl and extracted with pdftotext after the browser content-length failure. Executive summary calls it a Sonnet-class model from Anthropic; sections 1.1 and 1.4 describe training and final-release evaluation scope. Full-text checks find no model parameter counts or explicit architecture. Parameter mentions concern effort settings; section 3.3 describes safeguard probes and classifiers, not model structure.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: First-party article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable, and are not provided to users. Used for distribution status.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial service terms reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Together with the explicit nonpublic-weight policy, this supports the descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing. The document pipeline extracts text and converts pages to images. Sonnet 5.5 is active in its exact model specifications and explicitly supports PDF in its feature page.

sources.title: What's new in Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Exact model feature list explicitly supports PDF, vision, and server-side and client-side tools. Adaptive thinking is enabled by default; between_tools disables up-front thinking. Auto tool choice and strict tool inputs are supported, while forced tool choice is unsupported.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Sonnet 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Exact model summary confirms text/image input and text output. The architecture and training methodology section describes pretraining and post-training but supplies no architecture or parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Full later 144-page PDF downloaded and extracted after browser content-length failure. Numerous exact Sonnet 5.5 comparisons disclose no total or active production parameter counts or architecture. Parameter mentions concern evaluation effort, not model size.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Official directory lists Sonnet 5.5 in September 2026 and the later Haiku 5.5 card in October 2026; used to identify subsequent comparison material.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: The exact system card identifies Anthropic as developer.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact system card designation as a Sonnet-class model.

release_date.note: Announcement and specifications agree on the general-release date; this is not a training snapshot date.

open_weights.note: The explicit Claude nonpublic-weight policy applies to this model; hosted availability alone is not the basis.

license.note: Descriptive classification for nonpublic weights offered under commercial service terms, not a named open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count found in the full exact-model card, current transparency entry or later Haiku 5.5 comparison card. Targeted exact-name primary-source searches found no disclosure. API effort parameters do not indicate model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token production parameter count found in the inspected exact-model and later comparison sources. Evaluation effort settings and safeguard classifier descriptions are not active model parameter counts.

architecture.note: No explicit architecture in the inspected exact-model and later comparison sources. Internal-activation probes do not establish Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from another Claude model or an earlier checkpoint.

modalities.note: Text/image input and text output are explicit. PDF is a supported document format processed into text and page images, confirmed for this exact active model.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is enabled by default, with configurable effort; between_tools can disable up-front thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact model documentation supports server/client tools and auto tool choice with structured strict inputs. Forced tool choice is unsupported.

description.value: Claude Sonnet model with adaptive thinking and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Neutral description limited to documented features.

patch.notes: Total and active production parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed after full exact-model and later Haiku 5.5 comparison-card checks. Proprietary describes nonpublic weights accessed under commercial terms. PDF input is document processing through text and vision. Adaptive thinking is enabled by default, and auto tool choice is supported.

summary: Assessed all 14 fields: 11 verified and 3 undisclosed. Confirms release, context, modalities, reasoning and tool calling; adds proprietary classification and primary-source provenance. Total/active parameters and architecture remain null after full exact-model and later-card checks. Replaces the promotional description with documented features.
